January 9, 2026 - YGX was a South Korean entertainment company under YG Entertainment. It operated two sub-divisions: YGX Entertainment, a sub-label that focuses on production and artist management, and X ACADEMY, a dance and vocal academy.[1] In 2020, the label was converted to a full-fledged dance group and academy with all of its actors, recording artists, and producers transferred to YG Entertainment.
